name: ReferenceLifecycleValidation

archive.transaction: one short LLD-01 BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork
steps: load exact target by immutable ID and require lifecycle_state active
revalidate base_revision
load deterministic validator list from ReferenceDependencyRegistry for target type
execute every validator's indexed archive guard against the same UnitOfWork; each guard returns only has_blocker plus an optional first reason code and must not materialize unbounded dependent rows
if any guard reports a blocker, roll back immediately without inserting a command receipt or changing lifecycle state; return ARCHIVE_BLOCKED with preview_required=true
allocate lifecycle event ID and insert command_receipt
set lifecycle_state archived and increment revision
append reference_lifecycle_events archived occurrence referencing the receipt
insert required audit/result references
commit
rules: Contact validators include active requester/assignment/unfinished operational dependencies registered by owning domain packets
Dispatch Location validators include active Site-dedicated relationship and unfinished logistics dependencies from LLD-08/LLD-07
Customer Organization validators are registered by every owning domain whose active work would be stranded
archive never cascades deletion/unlinking merely to make validation pass
ordinary Beta 1.0 LLD-02 exposes no hard-delete command for history-bearing reference masters
full blocker enumeration is a separate read-only preview and never runs under the write lock

reactivate.transaction: one short LLD-01 BEGIN IMMEDIATE UnitOfWork
steps: load exact archived target
revalidate base_revision
run every registered reactivation guard/current structural constraint using bounded indexed existence checks
if any guard reports a blocker, roll back immediately with REACTIVATION_BLOCKED and preview_required=true; insert no receipt
allocate lifecycle event ID and insert command_receipt
set active and increment revision
append reactivated lifecycle event referencing receipt
insert audit/result references
commit
reactivate.rule: reactivation never deletes or rewrites the prior archived interval/events

preview.mode: read-only short snapshot; no BEGIN IMMEDIATE
steps: load target and requested base revision
iterate validators in registry order
for each validator obtain exact blocker count using indexed COUNT/EXISTS-compatible query and fetch only the requested bounded deterministic page
sum exact counts without materializing all dependency rows
return exact_count, bounded items and continuation cursor
preview.cursor: compound cursor encodes validator ordinal plus that validator's deterministic inner cursor; it is opaque to the client
preview.freshness: preview returns target revision and is advisory; ArchiveReference/ReactivateReference always reruns guard checks inside its write transaction

ordering: validators are ordered by validator_id; each validator orders items by dependency_type then immutable dependency_id, yielding stable global page order without full materialization
performance_contract: write-path validators use indexed EXISTS/guard queries and do not fetch dependent bodies
preview count/list queries are read-only and paginated
a validator that cannot decide safely returns indeterminate failure; indeterminate never means eligible
LLD-02 never holds the SQLite write transaction while the operator reads blocker details
failure_atomicity: stale revision, validator exception/indeterminate result, blocker, constraint error, lifecycle-event failure or audit failure rolls back receipt and all attempted lifecycle mutation.
